title: The Surprising Way Personality Types Can Boost Outreach Response Rates to 30%
summary: Gary Sinderbrand spent 35 years in wealth management, starting at Merrill Lynch at 23 and becoming one of the youngest million dollar producers in the firm's history before co-creating a peer training program that shaped more than 12,000 advisors. His argument is that the constraint on prospecting is not the list, it is fit: an advisor does better work and earns more from clients whose psychology matches their own, so the question worth answering before the first message is who you personally align with. He walks through Rainmaker, the app he built at ArcheMatch, which scores an advisor against Carl Jung's 12 archetypes, maps those archetypes to the professions that correspond with them, and researches individual prospects deeply enough to write an opener that lifts cold connection rates from roughly 3% to between 30% and 40%, with warm introductions through a client's own LinkedIn network closer to 60%. Worth listening to if you sell a relationship-heavy service and want a concrete method for narrowing a market by personality instead of by job title alone.
keyQuote: Even though they have the money and the tech to build it, if you don't have the content, the underlying intellectual capital, all you're doing is building a shiny toy.
guestBio: Gary Sinderbrand joined Merrill Lynch as an account executive in his early twenties with no sales experience and became one of the youngest million dollar producers in the firm's history. While still managing money, he co-created the Payne-Sinderbrand Program with Bob Payne, the longest running peer-based training initiative at the firm, which helped shape the careers of more than 12,000 financial advisors. He later produced at UBS Private Wealth in New York City and left the production side of the business about a decade ago to consult and coach. He now runs BetterPath Training (also known as The Rainmaker Collective) and is founder and CEO of ArcheMatch, where he built Rainmaker, an app that uses Jungian archetypes and AI to score advisor and client fit, alongside Ask Archie, a coaching companion trained on his own recorded advisor sessions. He also hosts a separate interview podcast called If the Public Only Knew.
takeaways: Cold outreach on psychological fit runs 30% to 40%, not 3%.
Warm intros through a client's LinkedIn land closer to 60%.
A sage advisor correlates with rulers, and rulers are CEOs.
You choose your clients. Not everyone will follow your advice.
Without your own content, an AI coach is just a shiny toy.
Archetypes get you close. Shared values are the real fit.
Giving away half his accounts nearly doubled his production.
